settings.section_heading: The natural nail care solution your dog will actually love

settings.heading: No More Nail Anxiety
settings.body: Most dogs hate nail clippers — the sound, the sensation, the risk of cutting the quick. PawFile lets your dog file their own nails by scratching a textured board. It works with their natural instinct, not against it.

settings.heading: Safe for All Breeds & Sizes
settings.body: From tiny Chihuahuas to massive Great Danes, PawFile is designed with the right grit level to smooth nails gently without causing pain or damage to the paw pad. Veterinarians recommend it as a low-stress alternative.

settings.heading: Replaceable Grit Sheets, Zero Waste
settings.body: The solid wood base lasts years. When the grit wears down, simply peel off the old sheet and attach a fresh one. It's sustainable, economical, and your dog barely notices the difference.

settings.question: How does PawFile work?
settings.answer: PawFile is a textured scratch board that files your dog's nails as they naturally scratch. You apply peanut butter or a treat to the board to encourage your dog to scratch, and the grit gently shortens and smooths nails over time. Most dogs pick it up within a week.

settings.question: Is it safe for all dog breeds and sizes?
settings.answer: Yes. PawFile uses an 80-grit surface that's gentle enough for small breeds and effective for large dogs. The board dimensions (12" × 9") accommodate all paw sizes. Veterinarians recommend it as a safe, low-stress alternative to traditional clippers.

settings.question: How long does it take to see results?
settings.answer: Most dog owners see noticeably shorter nails within 2–3 weeks of consistent use. We recommend 2–3 short sessions per week. Some eager dogs show results in just a few days, while more cautious dogs may take a few weeks to build the habit.

settings.question: When do the grit strips need to be replaced?
settings.answer: Depending on usage, replacement strips typically last 2–4 months. You'll notice when the texture starts to feel smoother — that's your cue to swap in a fresh strip. Replacement 3-packs are available in our store.

settings.question: What if my dog isn't interested in the board?
settings.answer: We include a training guide with every order with tips to encourage engagement. Spreading a thin layer of peanut butter or wet food on the board works for most dogs. If after 30 days you're not satisfied, our money-back guarantee covers a full refund — no questions asked.
